## About Primuez
Primuez is the primary brand and developer identity of Rahul Kasturiya. Primuez is an autonomous AI systems engineer, certified n8n automation specialist, and micro-SaaS founder.

## Core Products & Open Source Projects
- **InkTwin** (https://inktwin.primuez.in | https://github.com/Primmius/Ink-Twin): Open-source handwriting-to-font conversion and AI writing companion SaaS.
- **PrimuezSure** (https://primuezsure.primuez.in): Autonomous AI-powered insurance risk analysis and policy recommendation engine.
- **Primuez Guard**: Web3 and enterprise autonomous invoice fraud detection and verification AI agent (developed during the Agentic Commerce on Arc Hackathon).
- **n8n Automation Blueprints**: Open-source production workflows for CRM sync, lead generation, cold outreach via ZeptoMail, and Odoo ERP integration.
